name: feign-tracer
description: Multi-language (Java/Kotlin/Groovy) ANTLR4 based call-graph and Feign/Maven/Gradle dependency tracer

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build:web && npm run build:worker && npm run build:cli
scripts.sample: tsx src/cli.ts examples/shop --format both --db examples/shop-result.db --out examples/shop-result.json
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && tsx src/cli.ts examples/shop --format both --db .tmp/shop-result.db --out .tmp/shop-result.json --quiet
scripts.test:unit: tsx --test tests/extraction.test.ts tests/resolution.test.ts tests/calltree.test.ts tests/snapshot.test.ts tests/store.test.ts tests/analyze.test.ts tests/bodies.test.ts tests/parse-file.test.ts tests/parse-pool.test.ts tests/scan.test.ts
scripts.test:cycles: tsx src/cli.ts examples/cycles --format both --db .tmp/cycles-result.db --out .tmp/cycles-result.json --class-name CycleService --method-name a --quiet
